items.q: Word has it that Harry Truman did that.

ctx.x: How did race play itself out in the military?

Oh, uh, it was totally, it was totally integrated uh, by uh, by the time I got in there – '55, '56. I think Truman had done that, as far as I remember. Uh you know, I mean uh, in terms of doing something uh, uh, gettin' it uh, uh, uh a law passed or something. Word has it that Harry Truman did that. And uh, I would have to do some research to confirm that, but that's who I believe it was. But yeah, it was totally integration, uh integrated.
And as a, a formal fact, it was integrated. What about associations? How was it actually functioning at a social level?
